video_title: “My Goal Is To Impact The Game And Make Winning Plays.” | Joan Beringer Postgame Sound | 11.23.26

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on his defensive mindset and impact on winning
quotes.excerpt: When those days you can't really score, you have to find another way to impact the game.
quotes.quote: I just try to play hard. When those days you can't really score, you have to find another way to impact the game. I just try to play my best defense, be active, and just play hard. I always found a way to score, so it's probably the first time in my life, but it feels good because I think I found a way to impact the game tonight and we won, so it feels good.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer on adjusting his game when his shot is not falling: When those days you cannot really score you have to find another way to impact the game. I just try to play my best defense and play hard.

structured.context: Joan Beringer discusses his defensive mindset and finding ways to impact the game when his shot is not falling.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on the Timberwolves' team-wide focus on rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a mindset and I think we do it well.
quotes.quote: I think it's just we go as a group. We try to help each other and it's the best way to rebound the ball and it's just go consistently. I think it's a mindset and I think we do it well.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer says the Timberwolves rebounding success comes down to a collective mindset: We go as a group. We try to help each other and it is the best way to rebound the ball.

structured.context: Joan Beringer explains the team's collective approach to rebounding the basketball.

quotes.speaker: Joan Beringer
quotes.summary_phrase: Joan Beringer on his commitment to impacting winning plays
quotes.excerpt: He said just for me to find a way to impact the game, impact winning.
quotes.quote: Before the season starts, the team, the coach, he gave me a letter and he said just for me to find a way to impact the game, impact winning. So it's just what I try to do every game. Even if I don't score, I just try to impact for the win and I think it's just my mindset every game.
quotes.social_post: Joan Beringer reveals his focus this season is driven by a letter from his coach: The coach gave me a letter and he said just for me to find a way to impact the game and impact winning.

structured.context: Joan Beringer describes a letter he received from his coach regarding his role and focus on impacting winning.
